plateNote: Read on the promoted plate (art/staging/room-31/plate-01/candidate-lifted-1920x864.png, room-31 attempt 2, crop x 8 y 200 1520x684 -- frame.json). Every rect was read off the master and the plate: x less 8 and y less 200, times 1.263. The night companion (attempt 4) shares the frame.
walkableNote: THE GRASS IN FRONT OF THE SERVICE. The coffin's trestles stand to y 733 and the mule's hooves to y 700, so the band starts at y 740 and everything of the funeral is behind it.

beyond.note: Behind the band, where the service stands: Sowerby at the grave's head (feet y 502) is 314 in the master, the undertaker (611) 336.

scaling.note: ROOM 31'S DEPTH, FROM THE MASTER: Thad stood with his feet at y 859 and was drawn 400 tall, the undertaker 336 at y 611 -- a shallow hill, 0.26 a row, not Room 5's 0.68.

entrances.note: Up from Boot Hill, at the back of the gathering (doc 48 S2 beat 1: 'Thad at the back').
Out of the grave, at night (doc 57 E8: 'Thad is in Room 31 at night beside the open grave').

hotspotsNote: Generous over the thing the player sees (ruling 32), smallest first. The people are hotspots over their figures (Room 26's panner, errata 99 B): no figure at the funeral has a conversation, so the hotspot answers every verb (and TALK TO where it is written). Everything but the way back is the service's, and is gone at night (T_LAID_IN).

props.note: The hearse, and the pine coffin on its trestles in front of it with its lid propped and the name plate on the lid (doc 05, doc 54). One prop: they arrive and leave together. Cut from room-31's composition master by tools/art/room31-cast.py; gone by night (doc 57 E8).

occlusion.note: No plane: the whole service is behind the band.

figureLight.note: Errata 109, from the pre-playthrough art audit: the graveside is moonlit, and its whole cast -- Sowerby, the undertaker, the mourners -- was drawn in that cold light, while Thad, drawn in even neutral light for every room, stood among them warm, as if lit by a different lamp. A cool multiply and a little less brightness put him under the same moon. A measurement, not a verdict: Tyler's playthrough decides.
